policy: UI label matches and public documentation can establish that a feature affordance exists, but they do not verify underlying message graph changes, runtime transitions, storage fields or network endpoints.

operations.label: Start a new chat
operations.limits: No per-click trace; multiple matching labels were counted.
operations.test_goal: Observe disposable new-chat navigation and any conversation identity change.

operations.label: Select an existing chat
operations.limits: Sidebar navigation is captured, but exact selection controls were not mapped.
operations.test_goal: Observe selected UI region, loading state and selected path after a synthetic chat selection.

operations.label: Edit the draft
operations.limits: A contenteditable textbox is present within the main form. Draft lifecycle was not traced.
operations.test_goal: Measure generic editor dirty state and submit enablement without recording typed contents.

operations.label: Submit a message
operations.limits: A composer form exists but a submit-to-network trace is absent.
operations.test_goal: Correlate synthetic submission with coarse pending and completed states.

operations.label: Edit a prior message
operations.limits: Main-region edit-related button labels are present; message ownership and result unknown.
operations.test_goal: Observe whether an original message persists after a synthetic edit.

operations.label: Regenerate a response
operations.limits: Main-region regeneration-related button labels are present; no resulting response observed.
operations.test_goal: Measure whether a new attempt or alternative message appears.

operations.label: Copy a message
operations.limits: Main-region copy labels are present; clipboard results were not observed.
operations.test_goal: Observe a synthetic copy action in an isolated browser without retaining copied text.

operations.label: Branch into a separate chat
operations.limits: The public release notes document a Branch in new chat action; this capture does not establish internal ancestry.
operations.test_goal: Observe a disposable branch and compare distinct conversation roots without logging identifiers.

operations.label: Receive a streamed response
operations.limits: Stream-related syntax is present, but no actual request or stream event order was captured.
operations.test_goal: Record coarse response phase transitions and relative event timings.

operations.label: Stop a response
operations.limits: The saved snapshot does not establish a visible stop control or its action outcome.
operations.test_goal: Observe stop availability and terminal state during a disposable synthetic response.
